texts: Ah, a traveler. What brings you here?
Greetings, friend. What can I do for you?
Hmm. Another stranger passing through.
Welcome. I have seen you around these parts.
Well met, friend! The road has been kind to you, I hope?
A familiar face! Come, share news of your travels.
Welcome, welcome! Rest your feet. What tidings do you bring?
I do not know you. State your business.
Travelers bring trouble. What do you want?
Be quick with your words. These are dangerous times.
Another rat scurrying through the ruins. What do you want?
I do not talk to strangers for free.
Please... I mean no harm. Are you... are you one of them?
Have you seen them? The raiders? Are they close?
I was there when [topic] happened. [detail]
I saw it with my own eyes — [topic]. [detail]
Yes, [topic]. I was nearby when it occurred. [detail]
I have heard rumors about [topic]. [detail]
People say that [topic]. Though I cannot confirm it myself.
[person] told me about [topic]. [detail]
I may have heard something about [topic], but I should not speak of it.
Some things are better left unsaid. Even about [topic].
Why do you ask about [topic]? That is dangerous talk.
I am afraid I know nothing of [topic].
You would have to ask someone else about that.
[topic]? Never heard of it.
Even if I knew about [topic], I would not tell you.
That is none of your concern, stranger.
Ask someone who cares. I do not.
I... I cannot talk about [topic]. Please leave me alone.
Speaking of [topic] brings danger. I have said too much already.
From what I hear, [topic]. [detail] But you know how rumors spread.
The version I got is that [topic]. [detail] Make of it what you will.
